column3: MT 19:32. The Hebrew “passed over with the king the Jordan” is rendered “went on to the Jordan with the king.”
MT 19:35. “How many are the days of the years of my life” is rendered “How long have I yet to live.”
MT 19:36. NASB adds “added” in “an added burden.”
MT 19:39. “Choose on me” is rendered “require of me.”
MT 19:41. “Brought over the king” is rendered “accompanied the king.”
MT 19:43. “Close” is rendered “a close relative,” and “it burned to you” as “are you angry.”
MT 19:44. “Ten hands” is rendered “ten parts,” and NASB supplies “we also have more claim on.” “My word” is rendered “our advice.”
